# LOTUS Explore-rs

> Explore LOTUS with taxon filters, structure search, and Wikidata curation workflows.

All URLs below are absolute: the app is served from a subpath, so a
root-relative link resolves to the domain root and 404s.

## Core information

- **Official name**: LOTUS Explore-rs
- **Short name**: LOTUS-rs
- **Purpose**: Interactive exploration of chemical entity occurrence data
- **Data domain**: Natural products, chemical compounds, taxonomy, scientific references
- **Access model**: Free, web-based, no authentication required
- **Interface**: Four locales (en, fr, de, it); light and dark themes
- **Machine interface**: A WebMCP tool surface, see Discovery

## Features

- Search by taxon filters and structure input (SMILES or Molfile V2000/V3000)
- Draw a structure in the embedded Ketcher editor, then copy Daylight SMILES or MOL V3000 back into search
- Filter by mass range, publication year, and formula presence
- Browse taxonomy and references for each result
- Export results as CSV, JSON, RDF, or SPARQL
- Import TSV rows and generate QuickStatements for Wikidata curation
- A guided FAQ at https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/faq

## Discovery

Machine-readable descriptions of this app, for agents.

- [AI capability catalog](https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [API catalog](https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/.well-known/api-catalog.json)
- [Agent skills](https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/.well-known/agent-skills.json)
- [Security policy](https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/.well-known/security.txt)
- [robots.txt](https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/robots.txt)
- [sitemap.xml](https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/sitemap.xml)
- Structured data: JSON-LD in the page head

Every entry above is also linked from the document head, because the one
live host ignores `_headers` and a `Link:` header alone is discoverable by
nobody. The `WebMCP` surface is not a separate endpoint: there is no MCP
server. It is the `tool*` attributes on the search form and on the two
curation forms, so a tool exists only on the page that renders its form.

- Search form: https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/search
- Curation forms: https://lotus.nprod.net/lotus-explore-rs/curation
